in_sanskrit.name: वृज्राज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over all serpents. Vṛjrāj is a name of the king of serpents, Vāsudeva, in Hindu mythology. He is also known as Aadi Sesha or Ananta Sesha, the primal serpent, who is believed to support the universe.

in_marathi.name: Brijraaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the cowherd land
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brijraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brij means 'cowherd land' and raaj means 'king' or 'ruler'. In Hindu mythology, Brijraaj refers to the king of the cowherd land, who is an incarnation of Lord Krishna.

in_bengali.name: Brijraaj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the cowherd land
in_bengali.long_meaning: Brijraaj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Brij means 'cowherd land' and raaj means 'king' or 'ruler'. In Hindu mythology, Brijraaj refers to the king of the cowherd land, who is an incarnation of Lord Krishna.
